subject_lines: Drop Alert: Your Next Kicks Just Dropped
Fresh Style Dropping Now — Grab Yours
preheader: Fresh off the line — the sneakers everyone's been waiting for. Available now, limited stock.
mjml:
<mjml>
  <mj-head>
    <mj-attributes>
      <mj-all font-family="Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" />
      <mj-text font-size="16px" color="#333333" line-height="1.5" />
    </mj-attributes>
  </mj-head>
  <mj-body>
    <!-- Hero Section -->
    <mj-section background-color="#000000" padding="60px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-text font-size="32px" color="#FFFFFF" font-weight="bold" align="center" padding="0 0 20px 0">
          Drop Alert: Your Next Kicks Are Here
        </mj-text>
        <mj-text font-size="16px" color="#FFFFFF" align="center" padding="0 0 30px 0">
          The freshest new arrivals just dropped. Engineered for comfort, built for the streets.
        </mj-text>
        <mj-button href="#" background-color="#000000" color="#FFFFFF" font-size="16px" padding="15px 50px" border-radius="4px" border="2px solid #FFFFFF">
          Shop the Drop
        </mj-button>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Product Image Section -->
    <mj-section background-color="#FFFFFF" padding="40px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        
        <mj-text font-size="20px" color="#000000" font-weight="bold" align="center" padding="0 0 10px 0">
          Fresh. Light. Yours.
        </mj-text>
        <mj-text font-size="16px" color="#666666" align="center" padding="0 0 20px 0">
          Be the first to lace up. Available in select sizes now.
        </mj-text>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- CTA Accent Section -->
    <mj-section background-color="#F5F5F5" padding="40px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-text font-size="18px" color="#000000" font-weight="bold" align="center" padding="0 0 10px 0">
          Limited Stock. Don't Sleep on It.
        </mj-text>
        <mj-text font-size="16px" color="#666666" align="center" padding="0 0 25px 0">
          Once they're gone, they're gone. Secure your pair before the next wave drops.
        </mj-text>
        <mj-button href="#" background-color="#000000" color="#FFFFFF" font-size="16px" padding="15px 50px" border-radius="4px">
          Get Yours Now
        </mj-button>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <mj-section background-color="#FFFFFF" padding="30px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-text font-size="14px" color="#999999" align="center" padding="0 0 5px 0">
          Nike
        </mj-text>
        <mj-text font-size="12px" color="#999999" align="center">
          Just Do It.
        </mj-text>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>
  </mj-body>
</mjml>
rationale: Bold black hero with white headline creates immediate impact and speaks to the streetwear-conscious target demographic. The product image sits in a clean white section to command attention, followed by a light gray accent section that reinforces urgency and drives the primary CTA. Minimal footer keeps focus on conversion while maintaining brand identity. The inverted button style (white border on black background) adds subtle visual interest without compromising readability.
